meta.title: Personal Systems — Map
meta.tagline: Everything built on the side, in six orbits around NOEMA: the Creator and its recipes, the worlds, the companions, the games, the tools, and the parked ideas.

nodes.label: NOEMA

nodes.desc: Local project memory: indexes every repo every five minutes, keeps re-entry notes and research packets. This map is drawn from its index plus project memory.
